depiction.composition: single profile outline with centered interior symbol

readings.meaning: question to ask or ponder, decision to make

ambiguity: May be confused with generic help/FAQ icons or other head-profile icons (brain, gears, lightbulb) at very small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: questioning, wondering, testing knowledge, or uncertainty

task_intents: decide on an open life question
take a cognitive or memory assessment

example_tasks.task: List of questions to ask the solar installer before signing anything
Decide whether to renew the lease or start looking at two-bedrooms
Make a 10-question Kahoot on ancient Rome for fifth period
Questions to ask hiring manager at the end of the panel
Journal on the three prompts from Tuesday's therapy session
Schedule Dad's baseline memory screening with the neurologist
Write down everything I still don't understand about the escrow closing statement
Come up with five good icebreaker questions that don't make the new interns cringe
Figure out whether we are actually driving to Montreal or taking the train

example_tasks_es: Preparar las preguntas para el cuestionario de historia del viernes
Anotar dudas para la consulta con el traumatólogo
Repasar las tarjetas de vocabulario alemán antes de dormir
example_tasks_ru: Составить вопросы для школьной викторины по биологии
Записать вопросы к педиатру перед прививкой
Пройти пробный тест по ПДД без единой ошибки

context_tasks.task: Book the back room at O'Malley's for trivia night
Buy index cards for Spanish flashcards
Read chapter 7 of Thinking, Fast and Slow
Pay registration fee for the psychology seminar

near_misses.task: Ask Bob for the spare garage key
Update FAQ page on the company website

near_misses.better: gift box or head with lightbulb

near_misses.task: Buy snacks for the quiz bowl team
Question the double charge on the water bill

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a human head in profile containing a question mark, universally understood as thinking, questioning, quizzes, or memory/psychology. It fits tasks centered on preparing questions, studying/quizzing, cognitive health, or resolving open decisions, though at tiny sizes it must be distinguished from head profiles containing gears or a lightbulb.
